name: A Boone mountain lot

place_source.title: Wikidata: Boone (Q893055), coordinate location (P625) and elevation above sea level (P2044)

blurb: A rural mountain lot on the forest edge above Boone: a mown clearing, a fence line and a woodpile backed by mixed oak, maple and hemlock, where white-tailed deer and red fox pass at dusk and juncos, towhees and jays work the leaf litter by day.

facts.text: Boone is a town in and the county seat of Watauga County, in the Blue Ridge Mountains of western North Carolina.

source.title: Wikipedia: Boone, North Carolina
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Boone, North Carolina", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: Boone has a warm-summer humid continental climate (Köppen Dfb), a rarity for the Southeastern United States, bordering on an oceanic climate.

source.title: Wikipedia: Boone, North Carolina
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Boone, North Carolina", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: Boone lies 1,015.9 metres above sea level.

source.title: Wikidata: Boone (Q893055), elevation above sea level (P2044)

facts.text: Boone has the highest elevation of any town of its size (over 10,000 population) east of the Mississippi River.

source.title: Wikipedia: Boone, North Carolina
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Boone, North Carolina", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: Winters are long and cold with frequent sleet and snowfall; Boone averages nearly 25 inches of snow a year, far more than North Carolina's lowlands.

source.title: Wikipedia: Boone, North Carolina
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Boone, North Carolina", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: Salamander diversity is highest in eastern North America, especially in the Appalachian Mountains.

source.title: Wikipedia: Salamander
source.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, "Salamander", English Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0

facts.text: Boone's population was 19,092 at the 2020 census, and the town is home to Appalachian State University.

source.title: Wikipedia: Boone, North Carolina
